description: eRank is a service for Etsy sellers that provides research and analytics tools. The members.erank.com host is its authenticated member area and also publishes an MCP endpoint for AI clients.
summary: members.erank.com exposes one OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://members.erank.com/mcp`, using self-onboarding OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and scope `mcp:use`.
